## Description {#details}

<p>Create a verifier pass.</p>


<p><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/namespaces/llvm/check">Check</a> a module or function for validity. This is essentially a pass wrapped around the above verifyFunction and verifyModule routines and functionality. When the pass detects a verification error it is always printed to stderr, and by default they are fatal. You can override that by passing <span class="doxyComputerOutput">false</span> to <span class="doxyComputerOutput">FatalErrors</span>.</p>


<p>Note that this creates a pass suitable for the legacy pass manager. It has nothing to do with <span class="doxyComputerOutput"><a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/llvm/verifierpass">VerifierPass</a></span>.</p>


<p>Definition at line 132 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/include/include/llvm/include/llvm/ir/verifier-h">Verifier.h</a>.</p>
